verification: Expected deterministic canonical JSON values asserted by exact-tree GitHub Actions unit tests; do not claim until run passes.
limitations: These are local serialized JSON sizes, not observed HTTP, token or dollar savings.
Cache is process-local and not authenticated; scope string is not a security boundary.
Storage, CPU, hosting, memory eviction, cache warm-up and upstream retrieval costs are not included.
Two genuine publisher observations have overlapping rolling windows, not measured incremental sales.
Constructed repeat task is not buyer usage or verified willingness to pay.
Free HTTP conditional caching and existing native caches remain unbenchmarked.
decision: Research only: do not deploy or monetize generic retained-base cache without buyer tasks, native-cache baseline and real unit economics.
